steps.note: S1.1.1.1.1 states that the first rows subtract Ja+Rc, the middle rows add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), and the last rows restore a,c, so the net target change (JV+RG)x does not depend on a,c, with the line-748 quote.

S1.1.1.1.2 gives the central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, says the side wires cancel exactly the intersection-one pairs and that intersections zero and two already give 0, and gives the self coefficient 3=1.
The plan treats only the bit case of the exchange; the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, and the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, appear nowhere.
S1.1.1.1.3 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) and says each invocation restores its own auxiliary wires.
The plan says every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels (S1.1.1.3.4), but it never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions from the paper's table.

S1.1.1.3.3 states the inclusion of the time-2 label in the time-5 label because t_X is orthogonal to t_Y, but it omits the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp and its dimension h-2, which are part of the sub-step's content.
S1.1.1.3.4 makes center 3->4, which loses h, the only decreasing edge, with L=Ich; S1.1.1.3.5 telescopes sources N and sinks Wm-N to the signed sum Wm-2N, and to the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L.

S2.1.1.1 says each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and contains a norm-one vector, so it is nonalternating, and that splitting off unit lines and absorbing alternating planes gives an orthonormal basis.
S2.1.1.2 derives additivity of weight mod 4 from the even intersection of orthogonal binary vectors, and gives q_V-q_U = sum over the orthonormal residual basis of wt(v)[v.x] mod 4.

S2.1.1.3 says wt(v) is odd, writes the phase i^{+-[v.x]} as (1+i^{+-1})/2+(1-i^{+-1})/2(-1)^{v.x}, and conjugates it by H^{tensor m} into aI+bX_v or its inverse, a faithful paraphrase of the H diag(1,-1) H = X step.
The plan gives the count of s_c kernels over the network (S2.1.1, S2.1.1.4) but never says that on k columns each residual vector gives one tensored factor K^{tensor k}.

S2.1.1.5 gives frame I for zero labels and C^{tensor m} for full labels, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a on the pair X_a->Y_a, and the repair by Z corrections before and after with the scalar i^{27k}; S2.1.2.2 covers the remaining sign as the undoing of the signed bank exchange.
S1.1.1.4.3 says s_b falls short of W_b m by N-2L_b>0 because L_b/N<1/2, and S2.1.1.4 gives the complex deficit 2N-2L_c>0 from L_c/N<1/2.
The plan never states the complex relative deficit eta_c=73/19906842167500.

S1.1.4.3 gives the chain deficit > 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}=m exp(-2^{-50}log m)>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta)=s/W, worked for the bit deficit, with the quote 'Both exact deficits...'; S5.1.1 fixes tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
S1.1.2.1 gives the pivot (topmost nonzero row, its rightmost nonzero entry), clearing by lower-triangular row and column operations, one rank-one block per pivot, and exactly a ones in Pi.
S1.1.2.2 chooses a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator and diagonal numerator in the finite table, so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S1.1.2.3 says a lower-triangular change costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order from still-original earlier coordinates.
S1.1.2.4 realizes each one of Pi by D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, and D_j<-H_i-D_j, which takes (h,d) to (h+d,d); S1.1.2.5 gives exactly a interchanges in all.
S2.5.1 gives E=64(W+m+1)^3 and B=s+E, and S2.5 writes Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20), but nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are never defined, so the constants are only partly stated.
S2.5.1 gives a per-invocation count of at most E, the leaf bound 8e, and the recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E.

S2.5.1 states the unrolled bound A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} (that is, B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu) and the total at most C_0 d^20 with the outer phases and scale, although nu is not defined and the inequality's justification is not spelled out.

S2.5.2 says a value at depth j lies in 2^{-(p+j)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^j, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact; S2.5.3 gets Delta=o(p) from 20*epsilon<1, with the 'epsilon C_1<1' quote.
S2.5.4 says every row of H_0^{tensor D} has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved, and that truncation toward zero errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P03 states 20 of the 26 sub-steps, with none wrong. The bit exchange, the matrix shear, the guard-width recurrence with its exactness argument, the phase-interface factorization and endpoint repair, and the bit rank-deficit chain are carried out with their content. Missing are the complex-case exchange coefficient (B3), the residual table (L1), the h-2 complement on the side edge 2->5 (L2), the k-column tensoring of kernels (P3), the complex deficit eta_c (R3), and the definitions of nu, C_1 and C_0 (S1).
